# This test attempts to reproduce one part of the replica movement observed in
# #171402. The cluster has an asymmetric regional layout:
#
#   - region a: 4 nodes, 8 stores
#   - region b: 4 nodes, 8 stores
#   - region c: 3 nodes, 6 stores
#
# With RF=3 and locality at the region level, the diversity-optimal placement is
# one replica per region. That means region c carries the same number of
# replicas as regions a and b, but over fewer stores. The workload is write-only
# and charges raft CPU to every replica.
#
# Suspected theory: locality diversity keeps one replica of each range in region
# c; region c has fewer stores; write traffic gives every replica raft CPU; and
# region c stores become comparatively overloaded per store. In this simulation,
# mma-count eventually settles, but only after substantially more replica
# movement than sma-count.
gen_cluster nodes=11 stores_per_node=2 region=(a,b,c) nodes_per_region=(4,4,3)
----

gen_ranges ranges=480 repl_factor=3 placement_type=replica_placement bytes_mib=64

# The assertion is deliberately on replica_moves rather than thrash_pct because
# the current datadriven assertion helpers only assert on raw time-series stats.
# The cluster starts diversity-optimal (see #171458), but mma-count still
# produces excessive replica moves. A 20m run is enough to show the issue: with
# this seed, sma-count has 11 moves on s7, while mma-count reaches 68. Expected
# to fail until the issue is fixed.
assertion type=stat stat=replica_moves stores=(7) ticks=1 upper_bound=30 issue=https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/issues/171458
----

eval duration=20m samples=1 seed=42 cfgs=(sma-count,mma-count) metrics=(replicas,leases,replica_moves,cpu_util)
----
